description: macOS notification hooks for Claude waiting states

hooks.command: command -v osascript >/dev/null 2>&1 && osascript -e 'display notification "Claude is waiting for your input" with title "Claude Code"' || true
command -v osascript >/dev/null 2>&1 && osascript -e 'display notification "Permission required for tool execution" with title "Claude Code"' || true
command -v osascript >/dev/null 2>&1 && osascript -e 'display notification "Input needed for MCP tool" with title "Claude Code"' || true
